description: Monitor a website or API address in one call, as the website guided setup does: a Website monitor (API with isApi) that opens an incident when the address does not answer or answers with an error, checked every 5 minutes (checkEveryMinutes) from the locations new monitors start with. The person owns it and is emailed when its status changes. An address a monitor checks already gets no second one. On OneUptime Cloud's Free plan each new monitor is billed as you use it, at $1 a month, and details say so. Acts as the person signed in (OAuth), with their permissions; an API key cannot.

address.description: 'example.com' (https is added) or a URL such as 'https://api.example.com/health'.

isApi.description: True for an API endpoint. Defaults to false.

name: set_up_website_monitoring
title: Set Up Website Monitoring
